answer: Prayers & Duties >> Death & Funeral Question ID: 2301 Country: Bangladesh Title: Is permissible to perform Namaz-e-Janaza of a person who has committed suicide by hang or taking poision? Urgently I need the answer. Question: Is permissible to perform Namaz-e-Janaza of a person who has committed suicide by hang or taking poision? Urgently I need the answer. Answer ID: 2301 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 702/697=M) Committing suicide is a major sin, but this does not make a person kafir until one commits considering it lawful. And, since it is difficult to find out; therefore regarding him a Muslim his salah of janazah will be performed: فی الدر المختار: من قتل نفسہ ولو عمداً یغسل و یصلی علیہ الخ Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
